asciichat_error_t acds_create_key_set_collect (acds_create_key_set_t * set, const acip_session_create_t * req, bool require_identity, bool * complete)

Validate order, bounds, deduplication and individual possession proofs. Errors clear the sequence. complete is true only when every key is present.
